high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "Collective Cultural." The post appears to be sponsored, as indicated by the label at the top. The main focus of the image is a black hoodie with a long, asymmetrical design. The hoodie has a hood that drapes over one shoulder, creating a dramatic and stylish look. The garment features two front pockets, adding to its functionality. Below the image, there is a call-to-action button labeled "Shop Now," suggesting that viewers can purchase the hoodie directly from the post.
